item.title: Sustainable Molded Pulp Packaging: From Raw Material to Finished Product
item.description:
Sustainable Packaging: Our Molded Pulp Production Journey
#

Climate change and environmental degradation have underscored the urgent need for sustainable solutions in packaging. At the core of our approach is a commitment to using biodegradable materials that minimize ecological impact and promote resource reuse. Our molded pulp products are crafted from discarded and recyclable paper sourced from paper mills, offering a natural alternative to plastic packaging. Molded pulp decomposes naturally, significantly reducing environmental harm. Throughout our production process, we strictly avoid chemical additives, ensuring that every product maintains its most natural composition—a principle we uphold with pride.

item.title: Sustainable Solutions with Wet-Pressed Molded Pulp Packaging
item.description:
Eco-Conscious Packaging: Wet-Pressed Molded Pulp for Modern Industries
#

Wet-pressed molded pulp is a forward-thinking packaging material crafted from natural plant fibers. Utilizing renewable resources like recycled paper pulp, bagasse, bamboo pulp, and wood fibers, this material is shaped while still wet and then formed under high temperature and pressure. The result is a packaging solution with a refined, smooth surface and precise contours, making it ideal for premium inner packaging needs—especially for smartphones, 3C electronic devices, tablets, and other high-value products. Its sustainable profile has made it a preferred choice among leading international technology brands.
